recording.value: US public domain: the original Victor 66016 issue was publicly advertised for sale by 16 June 1922, before the 1925 cutoff.
recording.note: Programme rule 2. The Morning Oregonian of 16 June 1922, page 8, advertises Victor Red Seal 66016, Prelude in C-sharp minor, Rachmaninoff, at $1.25. DAHR links the two candidate 1921 takes to both original single-faced 66016 and later double-faced 814. The source rights year 1922 is a demonstrated publication bound, not the session year or the contradictory Victor 814 MARC [1920] date. This transfer’s take remains unresolved; no modern free licence is inferred from the Archive upload.

rights.creditLine: Prelude in C♯ minor, Op. 3 No. 2; Sergei Rachmaninoff, piano, recorded 1921. Original Victor 66016 publicly advertised by 16 June 1922; transferred from Victor 814. US public-domain recording. Source: Internet Archive.
